_comment: INDICATIVE timing — NOT test-validated and NOT reproducible, unlike chart-data.json. Two snapshots: `untunedMsVsRtt` is mean ms/op for the untuned shape vs injected RTT (quick OrmVsGrackleBenchmark run); `overfetchCost` is median ms/op for deep-narrow (which requests neither the heavy nor the wide column) through Grackle vs the eager ORM under conditions that isolate compute, bandwidth, and both (grackle.benchmarks.orm.OverfetchTiming). Wide confidence intervals; treat as the shape of the gap, not authoritative figures. Regenerate charts with `sbt benchmarksSql/generateCharts`.
